thread:
rachel: Following up on the kv-eviction postmortem — recurring pattern: short bursts causing hot-key eviction and fallback to smaller models. We need concrete testing + owners to close the loop.

ben: I agree. Proposal: three test lanes: (A) deterministic regression promptset, (B) staging load profile that reproduces bursty hot-key traffic, (C) scheduled chaos drill that simulates eviction. Also add a lightweight continuous synthetic for early detection.

yusuf: I can own (A) and (B). For the promptset I'll capture three scenarios: single-turn cache-hit, long context with heavy KV reliance, and bulk embedding batch that exercises cache population. Plan to add ~50 prompts under `regress/kv-hotkey-2026`.

emma: I'll take (C) chaos drill and the runbook. I want a pilot in staging then a scaled run in pre-prod. Runbook will include exact metrics to watch and a rollback threshold.

hui: I'll add the synthetic and the deploy gating. Suggest synthetic `synth/kv-canary` runs every 5m and asserts response similarity + tail latency < 300ms. Gating: block deploy if fallback_rate > 0.8% over 5m.

rachel: Good. Let's make deadlines and acceptance criteria here. Also include who will open PRs for CI jobs and dashboards.

rachel: ACTIONS (compact):
- yusuf: create `regress/kv-hotkey-2026` promptset + eval job `evals/kv-hotkey-regress` (due 2026-04-12)
- yusuf: author k6 load script `load/kv-hot-burst-300-6m` + CI job to run in staging (due 2026-04-12)
- emma: write `runbooks/kv-eviction-chaos.md` and run pilot in staging (due 2026-04-15)
- hui: add `synth/kv-canary` (5m cadence) + deploy gating (fallback_rate threshold) + dashboard tile (due 2026-04-09)
- ben: instrument metrics `kv.eviction.count`, `model.fallback.count`, and ensure per-model tags (hosted/dedicated/private) (due 2026-04-08)

yusuf: Confirming dates. For load repro I'll use `k6` and a short dev command to validate locally:

```bash
k6 run scripts/kv-hot-burst.js --vus 300 --duration 6m --out json=artifacts/kv-hot-burst.json
```

yusuf: Load script will cycle hot keys with a Zipfian distribution to emulate skew and include sequences that force cache fills + reads.

emma: Runbook outline:
- scope: staging first, then pre-prod
- prep: ensure feature-flagged eviction sim and maintenance window
- step 1: enable eviction sim (3m steady)
- step 2: kick off k6 load (6m)
- step 3: observe fallback rate, latency p95/p99, routing errors
- exit: disable eviction sim and triage logs
- rollback: disable simulated eviction and revert routing weight if fallback > 2%

hui: For the synthetic check I'll implement two assertions: similarity >= 0.82 for embeddings and fallback_rate == 0 for the canary model. If similarity drops by >5% from baseline, open incident.

bot ci-bot: Note: when PRs are opened against `rls-evals`, `infra` or `runbooks`, include `cl/evac` label to ensure follow-up tracking.

rachel: Ben — can you confirm metrics naming and tags so dashboards are consistent? We want model_* tags and region tag to slice metrics.

ben: Confirmed. Using `kv_eviction.count` (counter), `model_fallback.count` (counter) with labels {model_variant, deployment_type, region}, and histograms for latency `request_latency_ms`. I'll add Grafana tiles and an alert if `increase(model_fallback.count[5m]) / increase(requests.count[5m]) > 0.008`.

yusuf: I'll post PRs for the promptset and k6 script shortly. Draft eval config will include metrics to fail on: p95 > baseline*1.2 or fallback_rate > 0.5%. Sample config:

```json
{"name":"kv-hotkey-regress","promptset":"regress/kv-hotkey-2026","metrics":["latency_p95","fallback_rate"],"fail_conditions":{"fallback_rate_pct":0.005}}
```

emma: Scheduling pilot: staging maintenance window 2026-04-14 20:00-21:00 UTC. I'll ping eng-oncall.

hui: I'll add the gating job to deploy pipeline: run `evals/kv-hotkey-regress` for 8m post-deploy; if fallback_rate > 0.8% then block and require manual approval.

bot ci-bot: Reminder: CI quota for `rls-evals` is limited in staging. Coordinate with infra when scheduling repeated runs.

rachel: Acceptance criteria for closure:
1) regress promptset + eval exists and runs in CI with pass/fail rules
2) reproducible k6 load profile and staging run documented in runbook
3) chaos drill pilot executed and lessons written up
4) synthetic canary + deploy gating in place
5) dashboards and alerts instrumented and verified

rachel: Please ack with :white_check_mark: and drop PR links below when opened. I'll update the postmortem board and add a follow-up milestone.

yusuf: :white_check_mark: PRs: https://git.internal/redwood/rls-evals/pull/501 , https://git.internal/redwood/load-scripts/pull/97

emma: :white_check_mark: Runbook PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/219

hui: :white_check_mark: Dashboard & gating PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/1402

rachel: Thanks all. We'll revisit in next postmortem sweep. Closing this thread once PRs are merged and pilot run is complete. :rocket:
